Class Main

java.lang.Object
Main
public class Main extends Object
Application entry point and top-level screen coordinator.

Creates the JFrame and a CardLayout container that holds every named screen. Screen transitions are initiated by calling the public show*() / start*() methods from child panels, keeping all navigation logic in one place.

Card names:

  • "MENU" – MenuPanel
  • "LOGIN" – LoginPanel
  • "PLAYER_SCREEN" – PlayerScreen
  • "LEVEL_SELECT" – LevelSelectPanel (created on demand)
  • "PLAY GAME" – GamePanel (created on demand)
  • "TUTORIAL_GAME" – GamePanel (tutorial, created on demand)
  • "STATS_PAGE" – StatsPage
  • "HIGHSCORE" – HighscorePanel
  • "TUTORIAL" – InstructionPanel
  • "PARENTAL" – ParentalControlPanel
